Abantu abayizigidigidi eziyisishiyagalombili, ingxoxo eyodwa. Lapha, ulimi alusahlukanisi muntu.
Namuhla, inethiwekhi eyodwa isula lowo mngcele:
uyakhuluma, omunye akuzwe, noma ngabe ukuphi emhlabeni.
Ulimi lwakho, isiko lakho, indlela yakho yokukhuluma: umhlaba wonke ekugcineni ungakuzwa.
Wonke umuntu ojoyina nathi usondeza imihlaba emibili.
Wonke umlayezo, yonke ikholi ihunyushelwa olimini lomamukeli. Akukho okudingeka ukwenze: ukhuluma nje.

Izingxoxo zakho, izithombe zabathandekayo bakho, ubani oku-inthanethi, ubani osefundile. Konke osukwazi kakade, ngaphandle kokuthi lapha wonke umuntu ukubhalela ngolimi lwakhe bese wena ufunda ngolwakho.
Wena: Amaholide amahle kuwo wonke umndeni wakho 🎉
Livule bese uthinta “Faka uhlelo lokusebenza”: lizohlala esikrinini sakho sasekhaya nesithonjana salo, njengohlelo olujwayelekile. Igama lakho, ulimi lwakho, kulungile.
Thumela isixhumanisi sakho nge-SMS noma ngomlayezo. Uzokuthola ngokuthinta kanye.
Bhala noma ushaye ucingo ngolimi lwakho. Omunye ukufunda futhi akuzwe ngolimi lwakhe.
I-akhawunti eyodwa, inethiwekhi eyodwa, ubulula obufanayo yonke indawo.
Imilayezo, imilayezo yezwi namakholi nabantu oxhumana nabo. Wonke umuntu ubhala futhi akhulume ngolimi lwakhe, omunye amukele ngolwakhe.
Ubuso nobuso nomuntu ongalukhulumi ulimi lwakho: ucingo luphakathi kwenu, ngamunye nemakrofoni yakhe.
Izifundo ezimfushane nemisebenzi yokuzijwayeza ukuze ukhulume ulimi olusha wedwa.
Ngaphezu kakhulu kohlelo lokusebenza: i-{OW} ifuna ukuba yisikhungo sokushintshana komhlaba. Ukukhuluma, ukufunda, ukuthenga, ukuthengisa, ukusebenza, ukuhlangana: wonke umuntu ngolimi lwakhe.
Namuhla, ukuhumusha kusebenza ngaphakathi kwe-{OW}. Ukukuxhumanisa nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana yindlela esiyilandelayo.
Iphrofayela nesithombe sakho kubonwa kuphela ngabantu oxhumana nabo.
Kuvuleka kusiphequluli futhi kufakwa ocingweni ngesenzo esisodwa.
Yasungulwa eFrance ngumsunguli wayo, ngaphandle kwezikhangiso.
Inhloso yethu: isikhungo sokushintshana komhlaba, ukuze wonke umuntu, noma ngabe ukuphi, akwazi ukukhuluma, ukufunda nokuhweba nomhlaba wonke.
Amakholi evidiyo ahunyushiwe, anemibhalo engezansi ngolimi lwakho.
Thengisa, thenga, ngenisa izimpahla, thumela imali futhi ulandele imakethe yamasheya nomhlaba wonke, ngamunye ngolimi lwakhe.
Yiba ngomunye wabaqalile. Mema umuntu oseduze nawe, futhi ndawonye masenze umhlaba ukhulume.
Cela noma unikeze usizo, mahhala, kubantu bomhlaba wonke.
Thatha isithombe sencwadi noma somuthi obhaliwe: uyifunde ngolimi lwakho.
Izinombolo eziphuthumayo zezwe ngalinye nemisho esindisa impilo, ihunyushiwe.
